sections.note: rc2 — global footer, see proposed rule

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page block with the line 'The best no-code platform for ...' followed by a thin '| |' separator/social row, appearing verbatim at the end of nearly every captured page across templates.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; exclude from per-page block inventory and model once as a shared footer fragment.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical wording/layout recurs across landing, compare, and category templates — a shared footer partial, not page content.

provenance.evidence: C130 rc2c1/rc2c2 'The best no-code platform for...' + '| |'

proposed_rules.trigger: Two adjacent [bg:color] containers each repeating the same short promo phrase many times (e.g. [2x16] 'Black Friday' x16), offset horizontally with negative/positive x coordinates, implementing a seamless CSS marquee/ticker loop.
proposed_rules.decision: Collapse both duplicate containers into ONE 'marquee-banner' block instance carrying the promo text once; do not emit 16x2 repeated rows nor two separate blocks.
proposed_rules.rationale: The duplication is a CSS infinite-scroll technique (content doubled for seamless looping), not distinct content items. Rejected alternatives: (a) apply the generic repeating-cards-are-one-block rule literally and emit a 32-row block — floods the block table with meaningless duplicates; (b) treat as decorative-graphics-are-noise and drop entirely — rejected because the promo text is meaningful, authorable page content (a sale campaign banner).

provenance.evidence: C130 rc3/rc4 [2x16][bg:color] duplicate 'Black Friday' ticker at @-119,-19 and @137,-19

notes: Landing page (page-19, black-friday-sale) reusing the standard homepage-style template (nav, hero, trust logos, feature sections, FAQ) plus a seasonal Black Friday marquee banner rendered as two duplicated ticker containers for a seamless scroll effect.
